page_title: MCI 3-3 TOT | Manchester City v Tottenham Hotspur 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Ven M. Thigh Injury

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.

90+7' There's a break in play and referee Simon Hooper must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Manchester City using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+7' PENALTY APPEAL by Manchester City, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+7' A quickly taken corner by Manchester City.
90+6' Substitution. Brennan Johnson did his best and is replaced by Jamie Donley (Tottenham).

90+6' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) talks out of turn to the referee and subsequently receives a yellow card. His behaviour towards the referee was not friendly. He should be thankful, it could have been much worse!
90+5' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+4' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+2' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' 3 - 3 The ball hits the back of the net! Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) meets a brilliant cross from Brennan Johnson and scores with a bullet header from close range into the top left corner off the post. Ederson has no chance of stopping that. The score is 3:3.
90' The Manchester City players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
88' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
87' Yves Bissouma will be replaced by Richarlison (Tottenham).
87' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Julian Alvarez is replaced by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
87' That's the end of the game for Josko Gvardiol, who is replaced by Nathan Ake (Manchester City).
87' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) has tested the patience of referee Simon Hooper and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

81' 3 - 2 Goal! Jack Grealish (Manchester City) takes a short pass from Erling Haaland in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 3:2.
80' The shots on goal statistics – 3:3.
79' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) replaces Giovani Lo Celso.
76' Some great controlled play and passing from Manchester City. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
75' CHANCE! Rodri (Manchester City) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
74' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
73' A substitution has been made. Phil Foden is replaced by Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
73' Simon Hooper couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ben Davies (Tottenham) and blew his whistle.
72' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.
69' 2 - 2 Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and fires a low shot towards the bottom left corner that goes in off the post.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.
67' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
64' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
63' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
61' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
60' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
60' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) tackles a bit over-zealously and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
59' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
56' The ball is cleared after Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
56' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
56' The free kick into the penalty area from Jack Grealish (Manchester City) is cleared.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester City comes to nothing.
54' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires a low shot from the edge of the box to the middle of the goal, but Ederson is equal to it.
52' Substitution. Jeremy Doku walks off the pitch and Jack Grealish (Manchester City) comes on as a substitute.
52' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
50' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Manchester City, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Poor challenge! Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) is penalised for tripping and Simon Hooper blows his whistle.
48' Rodri (Manchester City) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.

47' Tottenham are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
47' Manchester City take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

46' A sweet pass finds Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
46' Ange Postecoglou has made a change at the break. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg has come on in place of Bryan Gil (Tottenham).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Simon Hooper has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Some patient build-up play from Manchester City as they look to unlock the defence.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
43' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City). Simon Hooper saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
42' Bryan Gil (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
42' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
41' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
38' Yellow card. Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
36' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
35' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the left post. Good effort!
34' Rodri (Manchester City) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.
31' 2 - 1 It's 2:1! Julian Alvarez feeds Phil Foden (Manchester City) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
31' Tottenham keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
30' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the crossbar!
28' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
27' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
25' A spell of possession for Manchester City in an attempt to control the game.
24' None of the Tottenham players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
23' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
23' A long pass, executed by Phil Foden (Manchester City), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
21' Tottenham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' A pass into the penalty area from Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is intercepted by the defence. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
20' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
17' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

17' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
16' The resulting set piece from Manchester City is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
16' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) but poses no threat.
15' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
13' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
13' Phil Foden (Manchester City) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
11' Wonderful movement by Tottenham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
9' 1 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the left post of his own goal.
6' 0 - 1 Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Ederson with a low strike into the middle of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
6' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

6' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Guglielmo Vicario has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
6' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes.
5' Phil Foden (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
5' Manchester City can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
3' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
2' Manchester City are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The match has just started.
Manchester City will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Simon Hooper.
